Bill.BriefDescription: Making a false or misleading material statement that results in an Amber alert.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to making a false or misleading material statementthat results in an Amber alert; adding a new section to chapter 9A.76RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.76 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person who with the intent of causing an activation of thevoluntary broadcast notification system commonly known as the "Amberalert," or as the same system may otherwise be known, which is used tonotify the public of abducted children, knowingly makes a false ormisleading material statement to a public servant that a child has beenabducted and which statement causes an activation, is guilty of a classC felony. (2) "Material statement" means a written or oral statementreasonably likely to be relied upon by a public servant in thedischarge of his or her official powers or duties.
